meta.title: Solar PV deployment and cost: installed capacity and levelised cost
meta.description: World totals. data.capacity_gw is [[year, GW]]: cumulative installed solar capacity at year end (all solar, overwhelmingly PV), from IRENA via Our World in Data (indicator 'Total solar capacity', metadata updated 2026-07-28), 2000–2025. Annual net additions are the year-on-year difference. data.lcoe_pv is [[year, US$/kWh]]: IRENA's global weighted-average levelised cost of electricity (LCOE) for newly commissioned solar PV projects, in constant 2025 US$ (OWID inflation adjustment with the US GDP deflator), 2010–2025. Values rounded to 4 significant decimals as fetched on 2026-09-30.
